info.title: Sympheny API
info.summary: Programmatic access to the Sympheny energy system optimization platform.
info.description:
The Sympheny API gives you programmatic access to the Sympheny platform for designing and optimizing multi-energy systems.

Use it to automate everything you can do in the Sympheny web application: create projects and analyses, model energy hubs, demands, supply technologies and networks, run optimizations, and integrate the platform into your own tools and workflows.

## API areas

- **Platform** (`/sympheny-app`) - manage projects, analyses, scenarios, hubs, energy carriers, demands, technologies and networks.
- **Account** (`/backoffice`) - obtain access tokens and inspect your user profile.
- **Solver** (`/sense-api`) - submit solver jobs, track their progress, and manage your job quota.

## Authentication

Request a JWT access token with your Sympheny credentials via `POST /backoffice/auth/ext/token`, then send it with every request in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

## Client library

A Python client is available as [sympheny-toolbox](https://github.com/urban-sympheny/sympheny-toolbox).

get.description: Here you must use version=V2. Also name must be unique

post.description: Here you must use version=V2. Also name must be unique
Needs at least 1 mode. Each mode needs at least 1 carrier INPUT and 1 carrier OUTPUT. Cannot have same carrier in both INPUT and OUTPUT
conversionTechnologies or storageTechnologies must not be empty

put.description: conversionTechnologies or storageTechnologies must not be empty

post.description: values array size must be exactly 8760, with period from 1 to 8760, and positive demandValue
demandProfileId and demandSalePrice must be exclusive
energyCarrierGuid must be a carrier with subType in: SOLAR_ROOF,BIOMASS,GEOTHERMAL,HYDRO,PROCESS_WASTE_HEAT,SOLAR_FACADE,SOLAR_PARAPET,TIDAL,WIND
